links.outcome: Accuracy of nonexpert staff annotations versus expert adjudication as reference standard
links.effect: Nonexpert staff annotations, used as the reference standard, were outperformed by LLaMA3.3-70B in 7 of 8 variables on expert adjudication; annotation accuracy rose with clinical experience.
links.quote: Expert adjudication confirmed that LLaMA3.3-70B outperformed nonexpert annotations in 7 of 8 variables and matched junior medical students.

unlisted_practices: Comparing Chain-of-Thought versus Quick Response prompting for extraction by variable type
Using locally deployable open-source LLMs for secure chart abstraction

screen.reason: Evaluates 22 open-source LLMs using different prompting techniques (Chain-of-Thought vs Quick Response) on retrospective clinical note abstraction from stroke patients, benchmarking against staff annotations and expert ratings.
